content.short: FreeBitcoins.com offers a free starting point on blockchains like Bitcoin Testnet with no information required.
content.description: FreeBitcoins.com helps people learn how to use cryptocurrency without risking their own coins. It features a real faucet linked between two websites, with an affiliate system that pays affiliates 1:1 on faucet hits and 50% of trade fees on the sister site AltQuick.com (altcoin exchange).
